newsitem.title: USA: Besicorp and chairman plead guilty on felonies.
newsitem.headline: Besicorp and chairman plead guilty on felonies.

text.p: Besicorp Group Inc reported on Thursday that the company and a top executive entered guilty pleas on two felony counts in U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, White Plains.

Spokeswoman Karen Keator said the company's Chairman and Chief Executive Michael Zinn and the company each pled guilty to felony counts for filing a false tax return and causing a false statement to be made to the Federal Election Commission.
Keator said the charges related to alleged campaign contributions made during the 1992 U.S. congressional campaign of Rep Maurice Hinchey D-NY.
Both the company and Zinn will be sentenced on September 19,1997.
In a prepared statement, the company said it was uncertain as to what effect or consequences this developmnent will have for its current or future business activities.

In March, the power and energy developer said its chief executive was the target of a grand jury probe into whether Zinn and/or Besicorp asked employees to contribute to Hinchey's campaign and then reimbursed them with bonuses, raises or cash. The company and Zinn were indicted for conspiring to violate federal campaign laws in May.
The indictment alleged that the company and Zinn made $27,000 in illegal corporate campaign contributions to Hinchey's campaign.
"Mr. Zinn apologizes to everyone who may have been hurt by his actions and accepts responsibility for the violation of laws which occurred," Zinn's attorney William Brodsky said in a statement.
